title: Fondamantal — Digital Album Player
label: Album Experience / Productized Media
summary: An album-centric experience designed to preserve sequencing, identity, and narrative context inside a brand-owned platform.
overview: The Digital Album Player presents releases as cohesive digital products—encouraging complete listening rather than fragmented track consumption. It transforms albums from playlists into intentional, immersive experiences.
problem: Albums are often consumed out of sequence with little continuity or brand ownership when hosted purely on third-party platforms. The artistic intention and narrative arc are lost in shuffle-driven consumption.
approach: Designed an album-centric layout unifying artwork, tracklist, and controls
Built sequential playback encouraging album-flow listening
Created minimal UI keeping focus on the musical experience
Integrated seamlessly with the broader platform visual language
Established reusable structure for future album releases
keyFeatures: Album-centric layout unifying artwork, tracklist, and controls
Sequential playback designed for complete album flow
Minimal UI reducing distractions during listening
Consistent visual experience across all devices
Reusable template structure for future releases
Seamless integration within the Fondamantal ecosystem
technicalNotes: React / Next.js with reusable media components
Shared audio player architecture with Music Library
Dynamic album data loading for scalability
Optimized image handling for album artwork
outcomes: Controlled, immersive release experience strengthening engagement
Platform positioned as a destination for complete album listening
Reusable template reducing effort for future releases
Brand cohesion maintained across all album experiences
